desc: Ideate the mathematical approach and derive the monomial-filtering formula.
Implement the complete Python solution with p=1/p=2 special cases, optimized A^p mod p, sparse corrections, and global sign.
Validate the implementation against all sample tests.
Optimize modular matrix multiplication for N <= 100 and p up to 1e9 (i-k-j loops, skip zeros, postpone modulo per row).
